reviewMethod: 16 timestamped RGB frames per clip; not continuous motion or human annotation
limitations: These are provisional assistant visual decisions for training selection, not ground-truth annotations or an independent evaluation set.
Sampled frames do not establish the absence of brief events between timestamps or at unsampled clip boundaries. A full-duration normal interval extrapolates beyond the sampled observations.
Blurred faces, occlusion and still frames limit judgments about brief physical contact. No identity, intent, relationship or audio claims are made.
sceneGroup describes visible settings only. It does not establish independent recordings, sessions, actors or original-media lineage.
All accepted recordings remain within the same VID training cohort. They must not be divided into a purported unseen calibration or holdout set without verified recording/session lineage.
The one ambiguous interaction is excluded from normal training until continuous motion can be reviewed.
